persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrībhūpatīndra marlladevasana bhotayā kvāṭha pra(7)tisthāyātā dayakase bijyāka

notes: The catalogue records NS 826, but the colophon text reads 'samvat 828' twice. The text was caused to be made ('dayakase bijyāka') by King Bhūpatīndra Malla for the consecration/establishment of the fort of Bhota ('bhotayā kvāṭha pratisthāyātā').
